rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3AA grading, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and zona thinning. Minor overreach includes specific localization/artifact interpretation not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality to frame prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, and the prognosis follows from the favorable factors. Slight overstatement of implantation probability and some speculative comments prevent a perfect score.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, especially support for single embryo transfer in a young patient with a high-quality day-5 blastocyst. Minor deviation is somewhat liberal endorsement of PGT-A after a single failed transfer in a 30-year-old.

Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle advice, and future evaluation. Some recommendations are generic rather than highly case-specific.
